uncited: This family extends NeRF training to predict semantic features or segmentation logits alongside color and density, enabling object-level understanding and editing.

It differs from standard NeRF training by incorporating external vision-language models (e.g., CLIP) or foundation models (e.g., SAM) to provide semantic supervision, addressing the challenge of view-inconsistent 2D labels through 3D-consistent refinement strategies like Cross-view Self-enhancement (CSE) and Region Semantic Ranking (RSR).
All methods in this family augment the standard NeRF representation $\Gamma_\theta: (x, d) \to (c, \sigma)$ with a semantic branch.
**Supervision Sources:** Supervision comes from 2D vision-language models (CLIP) or segmentation models (SAM).
Semantic NeRFs emerged alongside the rise of vision-language models like CLIP and segmentation foundation models like SAM.
